■The Mega Man Cyber World Pack is available now!

A special bundle including Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection Vol. 1, Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection Vol. 2, and MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline is available for purchase starting today!

Take down cyber threats in all 10 mainline games of the beloved Mega Man Battle Network series, and DiVE into the 2D side-scrolling action of MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline as popular characters across the entire Mega Man franchise ー all in one special bundle!

notes.title: MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline Demo is out now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=WaySNwbdpZc;full][/previewyoutube]
■MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline Demo is out now!
DiVE into the world of the Deep Log with a free demo of MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline! Play as popular characters from across the entire Mega Man franchise in this action-packed 2D side-scrolling adventure and save valuable Mega Man X game data from total corruption!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2183650/X_DiVE/

notes.title: Enjoy MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline with 100+ characters from the Mega Man franchise!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=oFLUE909ZS0;full][/previewyoutube]
DiVE into the Deep Log with more than 100 playable characters across all mainline series in the Mega Man franchise, including the classic Mega Man games, as well as the Mega Man X, Mega Man Battle Network, Mega Man Star Force, Mega Man Legends series and more! Take on unique challenges in more than 900 stages and enjoy MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline's 2D side-scrolling action with your favorite characters as you embark on a mission to save the Deep Log from destruction!
